forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+---
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: Give the own-model compaction summarizer no tools
+---
+## What
+
+The compaction summarizer on the session's own model keeps the session's tools. If the model emits a tool call while it summarizes, a tool body runs inside a compaction. Give the summarizer no tools.
+
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/RoutedSessionActorCompaction.swift:427` (the own-model tier) uses `backend.replacingTranscript(empty)` (`:32`).
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Resolution/LiveModelLoader.swift:835-838` keeps the session's tools in that copy.
+- The comment at `LiveModelLoader.swift:386` ("The call has no tools") is wrong for this tier. The flash tier has no tools (`LiveModelLoader.swift:134`), and it is correct.
+
+- [ ] Make the own-model summarizer backend a copy with an empty tool list (and the same model and prompt cache scope rules as today).
+- [ ] Make the comment at `:386` true for both tiers.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] The own-model summarizer session has zero tools (a test reads the tools of the backend that compaction uses).
+- [ ] A stub model that emits a tool call during summarization gets no tool body run. The call ends as the SDK ends a call with an unknown tool, and compaction reports its usual failure path.
+- [ ] The flash tier is unchanged.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/SummarizerSubmissionTests.swift` (or a new `SummarizerToolsTests.swift`): the criteria above.
+- [ ] `swift test` in FoundationModelsRouter: all tests pass, with no new warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then implement until they pass. #no-queue
\ No newline at end of file
